phaseBoundary.readOnly: Does not call Current(), create presentation, inspect desired pane flags, or mutate panes.
phaseBoundary.ordering: Enable and outer EndLayout call Suppress synchronously. Its loop applies every wxAuiPaneInfo::Hide flag before manager_.Update. Hide is a flag setter; no callback or yield occurs in that loop.
phaseBoundary.reentrancy: An Update-dispatched publication sees suppression flags already applied. A nested BeginLayout raises depth before Restore; readiness stays false until outer EndLayout reapplies suppression.
phaseBoundary.limit: This observes UI-thread presentation state, not return from wxAUI Update or native repaint completion. Native visibility is separately asserted once.
phaseBoundary.selection: Return uses the actual returned process ID plus an epoch newer than the file read before restarting Legacy. Readiness never filters ENC, pane state, geometry or rail contents; the first ready publication is asserted once.
phaseBoundary.failure: Missing or malformed readiness fails immediately; wrong PID, stale epoch or incomplete phase times out.
